title: BenchX environment identity
description: The shape of coordinates.environment when coordinates.environment.schema is "benchx/env-identity/0.1.0" (docs/design/runner-schema.md §5.2). identity holds the fields that name the machine and key its environment record; facts holds everything else known about the system during the attempt. What a comparison fixes is a projection's business (schemas/projection/0.1.0).
$comment: coordinates.environment.identity is deliberately open in schemas/measurement-result/0.1.0 (minProperties: 1 only), to allow other identity schemas. A validator applies this schema to a result's coordinates.environment object only when its schema field equals "benchx/env-identity/0.1.0". GPU UUIDs are facts, not identity, so that swapping a card of the same model keeps naming the same machine; the device a result used is coordinates.resource_selection, not here.

gpus.description: Visible accelerators by model. GPU UUIDs are facts, not here.

policy.description: The environment policy applied, as name@version (schemas/environment-policy/0.1.0).

enforced.description: The values the policy actually applied, keyed by check name (runner-schema.md §4.1).

facts.description: Other facts about the system during the attempt, nested by group (runner-schema.md §5.3): os (kernel, release), libc, cpu (microcode, governor, boost, smt), gpu (driver, uuids, clocks_locked_mhz), firmware, container (image_digest), runtime, process (environment, cgroup), hostname, and one object per context collector. null means read but undeterminable.
